selection_note: Sealed identities from the prepared 119-image pool; do not rerun randomized source-negative selection after training-policy changes. Original exploratory selection excluded the old planned 400+24 water training inputs; final overlap is rechecked against the actual clean training dataset.
label_note: Exact six-decimal YOLO label hashes pin visible-keypoint-derived rodent envelopes and connected original water-component envelopes. These references are not certified full-body boxes or segmentation masks.
negative_note: Ten retained wet-surface references were conservatively reviewed without predictions; labels are not proof of a dry surface or a field safety guarantee. Ten source-negative conflicts/ambiguous inputs are archived by exact source identity.
deployment_note: Same public source domains, not a new field study. This pool must not be used to tune a model after first evaluation.
label_line_ending_note: Exact label bytes were originally written on Windows; reconstruction preserves CRLF on all operating systems.
